## Purpose

Forward trace from L1 through L2 and L3 to verification artifacts. This file is regenerated from `L1-REQ.md`, `L2-REQ.md`, `L3-REQ.md`, the `@pytest.mark.requirement` markers in `python/tests/`, the `/// Requirements:` doc-comment tags above `#[test]` items in Rust source, and the Catch2 tag markers in `cpp/tests/`, each time `scripts/build-trace-matrix.py` is run.

## Status rollup

Status is computed by `scripts/build-trace-matrix.py`'s rollup rule. This matrix is the single source of truth for live status; the source docs `L1-REQ.md`, `L2-REQ.md`, and `L3-REQ.md` carry only spec content.

* **Draft** — Test verification is required but no test marker found.
* **Implemented** — at least one test marker exists (leaf), or every child rolls up to Implemented.
* **Implemented (I)** / **(A)** / **(D)** — the spec declares verification by Inspection / Analysis / Demonstration only **and** names the artifact carrying that check on an `**Evidence**` line, shown in the artifact column. A declared method with no evidence is a plan rather than a result and stays **Draft**. Combinations appear as e.g. ``Implemented (A+I)``.
* **Partially Implemented** — at least one child is Implemented but others are Draft, or the row itself has direct artifacts but its children include Drafts.
